title: Machine learning model predicts mental health crises from health records
summary: A model using electronic health records to flag patients at risk of a mental health crisis over 28 days reached an AUROC of 0.797, with 58% sensitivity at 85% specificity. A six-month prospective study in clinical practice found its predictions useful for managing caseloads or mitigating risk in 64% of cases. Caveat: modest precision (AUPRC 0.159), and one co-author is from the company that built the tool.
ai_technology: Machine learning model on electronic health records
organization: Koa Health; University of Warwick; Universitat Pompeu Fabra; Birmingham and Solihull Mental Health NHS Foundation Trust
